about_the_game:
Desktop Pet Monkey: Time to Slack Off!

Desktop Pet Monkey: Time to Slack Off! is an idle desktop companion and dress-up game designed specifically for office workers and heavy computer users.

Your star is a cheeky monkey in the corner of your screen who furiously taps the keyboard in sync with your mouse and keyboard activity. The more you use your computer, the more coins and decorations it collects. Use them to customize your monkey with hats, wigs, sunglasses, outfits, and even unlock desktop decorations to personalize its little space.

This isn’t just a pet-raising idle game — it’s your secret tool for discreetly slacking off at work. With several simple mini-games built in (continuously updated), a transparent, draggable window, and the ability to hide instantly by clicking outside, it seamlessly fits into your daily workflow. Even if your boss walks by, it just looks like a harmless popup.

Key Features:

  • Idle Loot System
    No manual input needed. As you work on your computer, the monkey automatically types and drops coins and various decorations.

  • Rich Dress-Up and Decorating
    Unlock a wide variety of hats, hairstyles, outfits, and desktop decor to create your unique monkey.

  • Transparent Floating Window, Maximum Stealth
    Compact, draggable window that blends effortlessly into your workspace.

  • Built-in Lightweight Mini-Games
    Pause or hide at any time without disrupting your work rhythm. A safer way to slack off than scrolling on your phone. Clicking outside the window instantly pauses and hides the game for quick switching.

  • Trade Decorations and Recycle Coins
    Sell extra decorations to avoid waste, and use coins to buy even more new outfits in the game shop. A closed-loop progression system—bad luck? No worries!

Perfect For:

  • Players who enjoy casual pet care and dress-up

  • Office workers who want a discreet way to take breaks without using their phones

  • People who want a stress-relieving companion without losing focus

  • Anyone who loves tiny desktop buddies and collecting rewards

When work becomes background noise,
let Malu (the monkey) keep you company and make slacking off smarter.
No effort required, no risk of getting caught, and endless customization fun.
Desktop Pet Monkey: Time to Slack Off! is your second soul on the desktop.

  • OS: Windows 10

  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 10500 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: A desktop pet made for office workers. Move your mouse or keyboard, and the monkey starts “working,” dropping coins and decorations. It runs in the background, collecting items, unlocking outfits, and playing mini-games. Click elsewhere to hide it—your boss will never catch you slacking off again!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
